synopsis: Fede has a perfectly organized life: she is a brilliant, ambitious and control-obsessed investment banker, who is about to fulfill her great professional dream: moving to London. Poncho, on the other hand, lives on a “sabbatical”, fleeing from responsibilities and defending an unhurried life. When both end up sharing the penthouse of Samuel, an eccentric neighbor, the coexistence becomes a frontal war between two opposite ways of seeing the world. But everything changes when Samuel disappears in a silent retreat and, suddenly, a stroller appears at the door with Rosa, a nine-month-old baby who is supposedly his daughter. Unable to contact Samuel and having no idea how to take care of a girl, Fede and Poncho are forced to team up. Between diapers, wakefulness, nipples, visits to the supermarket and improvised crises, the two discover that accidental fatherhood can be as chaotic as it is revealing.
